summary: Eating this food causes Poisoned for 10 turns.

fields.Eat: Consume to become Poisoned for 10 turns. Poisoned imposes Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
fields.Honey Badger: A level 6 Wildheart Barbarian with this passive toggled on can start Raging without spending a Rage Charge at turn start. The tooltip states 50%, while the source reports 55%. Only one roll occurs per turn, even with multiple qualifying conditions.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
